summary: Comprehensive testing of 7 new SEO pages (Bahrain GP, Monza GP, Monaco GP, Bayern Munich Hub, PSG Hub, Juventus Hub, Coldplay). All pages load correctly with unique visual designs, JSON-LD structured data (BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Product schemas), page-specific canonical URLs, and expandable FAQ sections. Link Wheel internal linking is present on hub pages.
critical_code_review_comments: All 7 pages have unique visual themes - Bahrain (dark amber/orange night-race), Monza (light Italian green/red), Monaco (dark navy/gold luxury), Bayern (red gradient), PSG (blue/red Parisian), Juventus (black/white stripes), Coldplay (cosmic cyan/purple)
JSON-LD structured data properly implemented via React components (BreadcrumbStructuredData, FAQStructuredData) and inline script tags
Canonical URLs are page-specific (not pointing to homepage) - verified on all 7 pages
FAQ sections use native HTML <details> elements for expandability - good for SEO and accessibility
Link Wheel internal linking present on hub pages (Bayern, PSG, Juventus link to each other and other hubs)
F1 pages (Bahrain, Monza, Monaco) have fewer hub links (only 2) - could be enhanced to include more football hub links
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 new pages are working correctly.
